newsitem.title: FRANCE: Finance commission delays vote on French budget line.
newsitem.headline: Finance commission delays vote on French budget line.

text.p: France's parliamentary finance commission issued a "reserve" on the regional planning line of the 1997 budget on Tuesday, effectively delaying a vote in protest at a reduction in allocations for this area.
The decision came after an address to the committee by the minister in charge of regional planning, Jean-Claude Gaudin.
Allocations for this area are set to be cut by 15.5 percent to 1.670 billion francs in 1997 from 1.976 billion francs this year.
The finance commission chairman, centrist Pierre Mehaignerie, said the cuts should be more selective. No date was set for a vote.
